attributes.probed_form:
(1) `static int sndFxFindFreeVoice(SndFxState* stv) { int slot; for (slot = 0; slot < 32; slot++) { if (stv->voice[slot].flags == 0) { return slot; } } return -1; }` replacing `for (slot = 0; slot < 32; slot++) { switch (stv->voice[slot].flags) { case 0: goto have_slot; } } slot = -1; have_slot:`.
(2) the same helper with the target's offset-accumulator addressing: `int off; for (slot = 0, off = slot; slot < 32; slot++, off += 48) { if (((SndFxState*)((u8*)stv + off))->voice[0].flags == 0) { return slot; } }` -- NEUTRAL-IDENTICAL to (1); MWCC canonicalises the two forms to the same object bytes, so the addressing cluster is NOT source-reachable this way.
